detail.title: WAKE Research Invocation: Autonomous Objective and Complexity Exploration
detail.summary: This invocation advances the 'Exploration of Autonomous Objective Formation' project by requesting a collector-based retrieval to support hypothesis formulation on intrinsic motivation, and updates the project status accordingly. It preserves active research on complexity emergence.
